title: Other import columns and their order are unchanged
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in as an admin, on the build under test, at Administration -> Invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Compare every other column name and the required column order against today's template.
  2. Import a file that adds a genuinely unrecognised column (e.g. "Widget Notes").
